**Nvidia** had the higher gross margin, by roughly 3 percentage points — but this is an estimate, because the Microsoft figure is not a reported full-year number.

- **Nvidia, fiscal 2026 (ended January 2026):** GAAP gross margin of about 71.1% on revenue of roughly $215.9 billion, from my recollection of its reported results.
- **Microsoft, fiscal 2026 (ends June 2026):** I do not have the full-year results. The first two quarters ran at about 69.0% and 68.0%, and fiscal 2025 was 68.8%, so I estimate the full year at about 68%.

The gap is therefore about 71.1% − 68.0% ≈ 3.1 percentage points in Nvidia's favour.
